dedupe_keys.name: farmconners wind farm flow control benchmark blind test with cl windcon wind tunnel data

description: Filippo Campagnolo publishes the fourth FarmConners wind-farm flow-control blind-test package using CL-WINDCON tunnel experiments. The free Zenodo archive is licensed CC BY 4.0. MATLAB structures contain wake flow, turbine power, shaft and tower loads, and pitch, yaw and torque states from three scaled turbines. The package also includes predictions from five participating models, comparison scripts, a FAST turbine model and empty-tunnel inflow mapping. These materials can benchmark control-oriented wake and load simulations against experiments. Related G6 data-three-turbine-1650-test-wind-farm-control-benchmark documents a separately described campaign. The deposit does not establish that the two collections are disjoint. Coverage is a scaled tunnel with selected inflow and control conditions, so full-scale transfer requires care. Measurement uncertainty and participant-model performance remain unverified. No archive was downloaded or comparison rerun.
